I'm organizing a Saturday repair cafe for our neighborhood. We have six volunteers, two workbenches, a small room, and a budget of 120 dollars. Visitors may bring lamps, clothes, or bicycles; we cannot handle mains electrical repairs. Help me plan the event. Explain a practical timetable, a safe intake process, and how to divide the volunteers' work. Include the reasoning behind your choices so I can discuss the plan with the team.
